# Read Primitives — Low Selectivity Filter

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Low selectivity filter - many rows match

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* Non-selective broad filter on lineitem */
SELECT
  l_orderkey,
  l_partkey,
  l_quantity,
  l_extendedprice
FROM lineitem
WHERE
  l_quantity > 1
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

        result = table.select(*columns)
        return result.limit(limit) if limit is not None else result

## Get the exact query for your run
